### Relationships
- The modification in `rndis_filter.c` directly addresses a bug related to the handling of packet information in the Hyper-V network virtual service client (hv_netvsc). The fix is linked to a previous commit (identified by the hash `0ba35fe91ce34f`), which involved copying packets sent by Hyper-V out of the receive buffer. The change ensures that the correct hash information is utilized, thereby improving the accuracy of packet processing in the driver.
